verdict.rationale: Zapier is a workflow automation product, so composing reusable sub-workflows is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents sub-Zaps, callable modules, or workflows calling other workflows. Stored actions (reusable single API action entries) and MCP tool bundles (shareable tool lists) are adjacent features, not sub-workflow composition, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
